dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Oakley arrived at MACC as a stray with a limited history. He was surrendered to the police due to reported aggressive behavior in his previous home. While in care, Oaley has been observed to be tense and stiff when handlers intact with him. Noted to hard stare at the handler when they presented a collar to him during the assessment. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Oakley Kazooie
